name: letterhead
description: Create branded HTML documents from notes, files or a conversation. Reuse brand profiles, apply packaged templates and styles, and check the result before delivery.

interface.longDescription:
Create a proposal, status update, plan, spec, report or meeting notes from your notes, files or conversation. Letterhead packages 13 document templates, 9 styles, licensed fonts and Node.js checkers.

Learn a reusable brand profile from an authorized website, brand PDF or local files, then apply its colors, fonts and logo to later documents. Confirm the document's structure before generation unless you already supplied an approved brief. Get one HTML file with embedded assets, light and dark themes, a layout for phones and printing, and stable section IDs for revisions.

Requires file access and Node.js 18+ code execution. Website evidence and Google Fonts need network access; local inputs and bundled styles support offline creation. If tools or assets are unavailable, Letterhead reports the limitation rather than claiming a completed check. Font substitutions are disclosed.

No plugin account or API key is required for document creation. Publishing is optional, runs only when requested, and requires a separate existing Markloop account and connected tools. Markloop is operated by the same author; this package includes no MCP server. Documents are delivered as files without publishing by default.
defaultPrompt: Create a client status update from my notes as a branded HTML file.
Learn a reusable brand profile from the brand PDF I attach.
Polish my HTML document while keeping its words and section IDs.
